title: Milwaukee IndyCar Race 1 postponed again to 6pm ET
source: All IndyCar, USF Pro Champinships and IndyNext Articles | RACER
excerpt: Overnight rain and thunderstorms have undone the IndyCar Series’ plans to resume Saturday’s Snap-On Race 1 at the Milwaukee Mile this morning. Rain is expected to continue for a brief period before finishing for the day.

title: IndyCar's Race 1 at Milwaukee postponed, set to resume Sunday
source: All IndyCar, USF Pro Champinships and IndyNext Articles | RACER
excerpt: Due to inclement weather and difficulties drying the track, the red-flagged race was unable to continue Saturday night and has been postponed to 8 a.m. CT/9 a.m. ET on Sunday.

title: O’Ward leads IndyCar Race 1 in Milwaukee at red flag
source: All IndyCar, USF Pro Champinships and IndyNext Articles | RACER
excerpt: Light but persistent showers brought an halt to Saturday’s IndyCar Series race at the Milwaukee Mile, now set to resume Sunday morning.

title: McLaughlin, Palou split Milwaukee IndyCar poles, but only one will start from the front
source: All IndyCar, USF Pro Champinships and IndyNext Articles | RACER
excerpt: Engine penalties for Saturday's race move Arrow McLaren's Pato O'Ward from fourth to first in the starting line-up.

title: Crashes mar Friday IndyCar practice at Milwaukee
source: All IndyCar, USF Pro Champinships and IndyNext Articles | RACER
excerpt: Kyle Kirkwood, Christian Rasmussen and Nolan Siegel all found the wall.

title: Newgarden quickest in busy IndyCar practice at Milwaukee
source: All IndyCar, USF Pro Champinships and IndyNext Articles | RACER
excerpt: With a single practice session to use for qualifying setups, race setups, and to perform pit stop practice, IndyCar drivers were in constant motion at the Milwaukee Mile Friday. Team Penske’s Josef Newgarden wrested the fastest lap from Alex Palou with a best of 159.430mph.

title: Don’t stop believin’: Saturday at Milwaukee will make or break Kirkwood’s IndyCar title journey
source: All IndyCar, USF Pro Champinships and IndyNext Articles | RACER
excerpt: Thanks to Alex Palou’s epic day to forget in D.C., IndyCar fans have a reason to tune in or turn up to the Milwaukee Mile and see if Kyle Kirkwood can author another miracle to keep his slim championship hopes alive.

title: Snap-on signs Milwaukee IndyCar sponsorship extension
source: All IndyCar, USF Pro Champinships and IndyNext Articles | RACER
excerpt: The Milwaukee Mile will remain on the IndyCar Series’ annual schedule with primary sponsorship from in-state tool maker Snap-on, which has signed a new multi-year agreement with the Wisconsin oval.
